title: task-054 follow-ups: FR-050 DAX-doc column-name fix, countries_with_epi abbrev filter, Weighted EPI Score SUMX double-count fix
description: Three non-blocking follow-ups surfaced by task-054's verification + AC5 attestation. (1) FR-050 (vocab_drift, open): dax_measure_library.md and rls_security_strategy.md reference gold_dim_indicator[indicator_source], a column that does not exist in the TMDL (gold_dim_indicator.tmdl columns are source_system, abbrev, type, indicator_code, weight, ...). The deployed measures use source_system (EPI vs WB source family) and abbrev (the indicator abbreviation; 'EPI' = overall composite). Each doc reference must be corrected to the column matching its deployed intent — NOT a blanket find-and-replace. (2) countries_with_epi query (silver-to-gold2.Notebook:3242-3246): after task-054 widened fact_epi_score to country×indicator×year, 'SELECT DISTINCT country_key WHERE score IS NOT NULL' now includes countries with any non-null sub-indicator, not just the overall EPI composite. Filter to abbrev='EPI' via join to gold_dim_indicator for parity with the TMDL 'Countries with EPI Data' measure (which uses gold_dim_indicator[abbrev]='EPI'). Stale comment updated. (3) Weighted EPI Score SUMX double-count: the deployed measure (fact_epi_score.tmdl) iterates ALL fact rows in the numerator (EPI composite + 30+ EPI sub-indicators + WGI indicators) but the denominator sums only EPI weights (source_system='EPI') — WGI rows pollute the numerator (source mismatch) and the overall EPI composite + sub-indicators double-count (the composite is itself a weighted aggregate of the sub-indicators). Fix: filter the numerator to EPI sub-indicators only (source_system='EPI' AND abbrev<>'EPI'), excluding WGI and the composite; denominator matches. Apply to both the deployed TMDL and the DAX library doc. No src/ mirror binds these (DAX library is a reference doc; TMDL is the deployed source of truth; the notebook SQL is Fabric-run).
acceptanceCriteria: FR-050 closed: zero remaining references to gold_dim_indicator[indicator_source] in dax_measure_library.md or rls_security_strategy.md. Each former reference is replaced with the column matching its deployed intent — abbrev='EPI' for per-country overall-composite filters (Avg EPI Score, Countries with EPI Data, % Spend - High/Medium/Low EPI, and the §10.3 filter-context example that mirrors them); source_system='EPI' for EPI source-family filters (Weighted EPI Score denominator); source_system='WB' for WGI (Avg WGI Score); source_system for the RLS 'Indicator Type' segmentation (EPI vs WGI). Changes align with the deployed fact_epi_score.tmdl + gold_dim_indicator.tmdl.

countries_with_epi query (silver-to-gold2.Notebook:3242-3246) filters to the overall EPI composite by joining gold_dim_indicator on indicator_key with abbrev='EPI', so the country set matches the TMDL 'Countries with EPI Data' measure (gold_dim_indicator[abbrev]='EPI') rather than 'any non-null sub-indicator'. The stale 'using the main EPI indicator / ANY EPI score' comment is rewritten to state the abbrev='EPI' filter and the task-054 grain reason. SQL is syntactically valid against the lakehouse schema.

Weighted EPI Score double-count fixed in BOTH fact_epi_score.tmdl (deployed measure) AND dax_measure_library.md § 5.1: the SUMX numerator is filtered to EPI sub-indicators only (source_system='EPI' AND abbrev<>'EPI'), excluding WGI rows (source mismatch fixed) and the overall EPI composite row (composite double-count fixed). The TotalWeights denominator uses the same EPI-sub-indicator filter. The corrected DAX is identical between TMDL and doc. A note documents that the EPI composite is excluded because it is itself a weighted aggregate of the sub-indicators, and that EPI data is single-year (2024) so the country×indicator×year grain does not inflate the weight sum.

Erik-gated Fabric check (AC4): after the TMDL change is published, confirm the Weighted EPI Score measure deploys without error and renders a sensible value (0-100, not inflated vs Avg EPI Score). No live report visual currently depends on it (task-054 notes: the three live visuals consume Avg EPI Score / Countries with EPI Data), so this is a spot-check, not a non-regression gate. countries_with_epi query correctness is confirmed by the next gold run producing an EPI Coverage figure consistent with the TMDL 'Countries with EPI Data' measure.

FR-050 SCOPE (verified): grep found 9 indicator_source refs — 8 in dax_measure_library.md (L338, L356, L397, L448, L465, L480, L830, L841) and 1 in rls_security_strategy.md (L44). gold_dim_indicator.tmdl confirms the real columns: source_system (string, EPI vs WB), abbrev (string, 'EPI'=composite), type, indicator_code, variable_name, policyobjective, issuecategory, description, parent_indicator, weight (double). indicator_source is not among them. The deployed fact_epi_score.tmdl uses abbrev='EPI' for Avg EPI Score + Countries with EPI Data, and source_system='EPI' for the Weighted EPI Score denominator — these are the canonical post-task-054 choices the doc must match.

WHY owner=both AND Claude can act first: ACs 1-3 are local edits to docs + TMDL + notebook SQL — no Fabric access needed. Only AC4 is Erik-gated (redeploy + spot-check). Same shape as task-054 / task-053.

WEIGHTED EPI SCORE SEMANTICS (the double-count finding): the EPI 2024 overall composite is itself a weighted aggregate of the issue-category + sub-indicator scores using the methodology weights in gold_dim_indicator[weight]. Including both the composite row AND the sub-indicator rows in SUMX counts each sub-indicator's contribution twice (once inside the composite, once standalone). Separately, the unfiltered numerator also summed WGI rows × WGI weights while the denominator summed only EPI weights — a source mismatch that inflated the numerator. Fix = restrict the SUMX iteration to EPI sub-indicators (source_system='EPI' AND abbrev<>'EPI'); the denominator uses the same filter so numerator/denominator are consistent. This is a semantic change to a deployed measure — flagged for Erik's AC4 spot-check; no live visual depends on the prior (buggy) value.

LOCAL VERIFICATION CEILING: DAX (TMDL) and the notebook SQL are runtime-verified in Fabric (Power BI / Spark respectively), not locally. ACs 1-3 are verified by inspection + cross-reference against the deployed TMDL schema; AC4 is Erik-gated.
